name: Django
summary: AI tools may be used if contributors disclose which tools they used and for what, and review and verify all output. Unverified AI-generated contributions may be closed without review, and automated AI reviews must not be requested on Django pull requests.

evidence.quote: Disclose which AI tools were used and what they were used for (e.g., generating code, drafting commit messages, writing documentation).
Review and verify all AI-generated output.
Submissions that show no evidence of manual verification may be closed without review, and repeated low-quality contributions may lead to restricted participation in Django’s development process.
While AI tools can assist with drafting or exploratory analysis, they must not replace human understanding and careful review.
